scope.selection: 20 current named SFA records at Changi Airport T1/T4, selected as a disjoint exact-license cohort from records with a CAG outlet roster/page match; this is a site-focused verification and not a Singapore-wide closure audit.
scope.prior_review_overlap: Checked licence IDs against prior refresh*_closures_access_*.json records; none overlapped.

sources.scope: Current promotion page lists T1 and T4 participating outlets explicitly under Public vs Transit headings; promotion period through 2026-10-21, so current on observation date.
Live terminal dining directory; outlet pages provide exact unit and Public/Transit classification for matched subset.
Exact branch-level pages for 8 of 20 selected licences.

limitations: A current official listing is not a physical inspection and does not guarantee service at the moment of access.

For 12 licences the official current roster names the brand and terminal but does not expose an exact unit-to-SFA-licence mapping; these remain exact-branch unresolved and are not claimed as individually verified operating.
No removal recommendation is warranted without direct exact-outlet permanent-closure evidence. Public-area classification comes from CAG roster categorization.
SFA presence is only the workbook baseline identity; it is not itself evidence of current operation.
